def max_removals(s):
    n = len(s)
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        dp[i] = dp[i - 1]
        if i > 1 and s[i - 1] == chr(ord(s[i - 2]) + 1):
            dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[i - 2] + 1)
        if i < n and s[i - 1] == chr(ord(s[i]) + 1):
            dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[i - 1] + 1)
    
    return dp[n]
